answer: The Verified email inbox bound by challenge-response signature with one identity per channel makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Even a quiet umber gets heard, because binding weighs evidence, not volume. The voyage test catches the lazy fake and the karst test catches the patient one.
